alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-08-13
Current:  2.39%
90d low:  1.89%
Move:     +50bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield rose to 2.39% on 2026-08-13, up 0.50 percentage points from its trailing-90-day low of 1.89%.

内容:
10 年期 TIPS 实际收益率在 2026-08-13 升至 2.39%，比过去 90 天低点 1.89% 高出 0.50 个百分点。

Why it matters:
A real yield spike this size raises the discount rate applied to long-duration AI capex bets, squeezing the valuation math on names priced for cash flows years out. It also tightens financial conditions broadly, which is the same channel C7 credit spreads watch for stress.

影响:
实际收益率这种幅度的跳升，会拉高长久期 AI capex 押注所用的折现率，挤压那些现金流要好几年后才兑现的公司的估值。它同时收紧整体金融环境，和 C7 信用利差盯的是同一条压力传导链。

Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dave Gura on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Signs the consumer is finally slowing sown. Today, retail sales post their biggest drop in more than a year as confidence slides. Oil rises as Washington threatens more economic pressure on Iran. ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
A Bloomberg "Open Interest" daily briefing lists several unrelated headlines — US retail sales drop, oil prices, Iran sanctions — and mentions in passing that OpenAI's revenue is surging ahead of a highly anticipated IPO, with no figures or sourcing attached.

彭博 "Open Interest" 的每日简报罗列了几条互不相关的新闻——美国零售销售下滑、油价、对伊朗制裁——顺带提了一句 OpenAI 营收在备受期待的 IPO 前大涨，没有具体数字也没有信源。

Why it matters:
This is generic market-roundup chatter, not a filing or a dedicated OpenAI report — it carries no burn-rate number or new disclosure. Fits the known pattern where most C3 MED alerts are just \bIPO\b keyword hits on daily speculation, not real signal.

影响:
这是泛泛的市场简报闲聊，不是 filing 也不是针对 OpenAI 的专门报道，没有 burn rate 数字，也没有新披露。符合 C3 已知的模式：大多数 MED 告警只是命中了 \bIPO\b 这个关键词，属于日常投机噪音，不是真信号。

alerts.body:
Severity:  MED
Feed:      https://feeds.bloomberg.com/technology/news.rss

Link:      https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-08-14/openai-on-track-to-double-revenue-ahead-of-ipo-video

OpenAI on Track to Double Revenue Ahead of IPO

OpenAI is on track to generate more than $40 billion in annualized revenue, roughly double its run rate at the end of 2025, according to sources. Bloomberg’s Rachel Metz explains how growth in paying ChatGPT users, enterprise adoption and coding assistant Codex are driving the surge, and why the enormous cost of computing power remains a key challenge for the AI company. She joins Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
OpenAI is reportedly on track to double its annualized revenue to over $40B ahead of an IPO, driven by ChatGPT subscribers, enterprise adoption, and Codex — with compute cost flagged as the key constraint.

内容:
据报道，OpenAI 的年化收入有望在 IPO 前翻倍，突破 $40B，驱动力是 ChatGPT 付费用户、企业采购和 Codex，但算力成本被指为关键瓶颈。

Why it matters:
Revenue growth alone doesn't resolve the C3 thesis; the piece itself names compute cost as the binding constraint, meaning the burn-rate side of the equation is still the thing to watch, not top-line growth. An IPO narrative also raises the stakes on whether unit economics hold up under public-market scrutiny.

影响:
收入翻倍本身不能解决 C3 的核心担忧——报道自己都点出算力成本是制约因素，说明真正该盯的是烧钱速度而非营收增速。IPO 叙事一旦成立，单位经济模型会被摆到公开市场的放大镜下检验。

What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield rose to 2.42 (2026-08-12) from a trailing-90-day low of 1.89 — a rise of 0.53pp, per FRED series REAL10.

内容:
10 年期 TIPS 实际收益率升至 2.42（2026-08-12），此前 90 天低点为 1.89，涨了 0.53 个百分点，数据来自 FRED 的 REAL10 系列。

A rising real yield tightens the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex bets and raises the cost of debt-funded data-center buildouts just as hyperscaler leverage is climbing. Crossing 2x the trigger on C10's trailing-90 low escalates this from a MED to a HIGH liquidity-stress read.

影响:
实际收益率上升会拉高长久期 AI capex 项目的贴现率，也推高债务驱动的数据中心建设成本——偏偏此时超大规模厂商的杠杆还在往上走。涨幅达到 C10 触发阈值的 2 倍，把这条信号从 MED 升级到 HIGH。

alerts.body:

OpenAI’s Revenue Run Rate Tops $40 Billion Ahead of IPO

OpenAI is on track to generate annualized revenue of more than $40 billion based on its current performance, according to people familiar with the matter, roughly doubling its run rate from the end of 2025 and bolstering the company’s plans for a Wall Street debut.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
OpenAI's annualized revenue run rate has surpassed $40 billion, roughly double where it stood at the end of 2025, ahead of a planned Wall Street IPO.

内容:
OpenAI 的年化收入运行速率已突破 $40 billion，约为 2025 年底水平的两倍，正值其筹备华尔街 IPO 之际。

Why it matters:
Faster revenue growth strengthens the case that OpenAI's spend is being matched by real demand, which cuts against the bubble-stress thesis — but a pre-IPO run-rate figure sourced to unnamed people is promotional framing, not an audited number, and doesn't say whether burn rate grew as fast as revenue.

影响:
收入增速加快，说明支出背后确实有需求撑着，这对泡沫承压的论点是利空。但这个数字来自匿名消息源、又赶在 IPO 前放出，带明显的造势色彩，不是审计数字，而且没说烧钱速度是不是也跟着翻倍了。

Here's What That Tension Means for Microsoft and Nvidia Shareholders. - The Globe and Mail Sam Altman Is Pushing for a $1 Trillion IPO Valuation for OpenAI, Even as SoftBank Faces a $40 Billion Loan Deadline in 2027. Here's What That Tension Means for Microsoft and Nvidia Shareholders.  The Globe and Mail ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: Sam Altman is pushing for a $1 trillion IPO valuation for OpenAI, while SoftBank — a major OpenAI backer — faces a $40 billion loan deadline in 2027. 内容: Sam Altman 正在为 OpenAI 争取 1 万亿美元的 IPO 估值，与此同时 OpenAI 的主要金主 SoftBank 面临 2027 年到期的 400 亿美元贷款。 Why it matters: A trillion-dollar valuation target raises the bar for OpenAI's eventual public listing just as SoftBank's own leverage comes due, tying OpenAI's capital-raising timeline to a backer's balance-sheet stress. That coupling is a transmission channel for AI-capex risk to spread from OpenAI into its funding chain (and by extension Microsoft/Nvidia, whose revenue depends on OpenAI's spend continuing). 影响: 万亿估值目标抬高了 OpenAI 未来上市的门槛，偏偏这时候 SoftBank 自己的杠杆也快到期了，等于把 OpenAI 的融资节奏和金主的资产负债表压力捆在了一起。这条链条是 AI capex 风险外溢的传导渠道——一旦 SoftBank 那头出问题，波及的不只是 OpenAI，还有靠 OpenAI 持续烧钱撑营收的 Microsoft 和 Nvidia。

That tightens the capex-payback math further if compute buyers get less memory per chip for the same money. 影响: 连 Nvidia 这样的头部 AI 芯片设计商都要降规格来应对 HBM 供应紧张，说明内存瓶颈已经真实影响到 AI 产业链最高端，不只是消费级或中端产品。如果买家花同样的钱拿到的内存更少，AI capex 的回本账会更难算。

alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.40% (+51bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-08-07
Current:  2.40%
90d low:  1.89%
Move:     +51bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield rose to 2.40% as of 2026-08-07, up 0.51pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.89%.

内容:
10 年期 TIPS 实际收益率截至 2026-08-07 升至 2.40%，较过去 90 天低点 1.89% 上升 0.51 个百分点。

Why it matters:
Real yields are the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex bets — a rise this size directly compresses the valuation of hyperscaler/neocloud names funding buildout with debt, and tightens the refinancing math the C7 credit-spread fuse also watches.

影响:
实际收益率是给 AI capex 这类长久期押注定价的贴现率，涨这么多会直接压低靠举债扩产的超大规模厂商/云厂商估值，也让 C7 信用利差那条引信盯着的再融资成本变紧。

alerts.subject: [C6-MED] Memory chip supply crunch will last 2 more years, JPMorgan warns - AOL.com
alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22HBM%22+OR+%22memory+chip%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 13:29:03 GMT Link: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE9nc0xTZ1JqcEZtbFRWYVFwenFQakU4bDdDVGVLTGtTUXk2bWdrVk42MWQ4SWVydGpRUFpkbUl5UlgxVFduRmZhR0NmVmNza2VTX0hDQVZ6MXk2UnNuNTBrTnRfQ09VVWpUV1daTEVNalNHSVZDSy1YUVRfUGo5Wms?oc=5 Memory chip supply crunch will last 2 more years, JPMorgan warns - AOL.com Memory chip supply crunch will last 2 more years, JPMorgan warns  AOL.com ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: JPMorgan says the memory chip supply crunch — DRAM and NAND shortages — will persist for at least two more years. 内容: JPMorgan 警告称，DRAM 和 NAND 的内存芯片供应紧张至少还要持续两年。 Why it matters: A prolonged memory shortage keeps input costs high for every AI server builder and signals demand is structurally outrunning fab capacity, not just a temporary allocation squeeze. That supports the capex-is-rational bull case, but also means margin pressure on anyone buying memory rather than producing it. 影响: 内存短缺拖这么久，意味着所有做 AI 服务器的厂商成本都压不下来，也说明需求已经结构性地跑赢了晶圆产能，不只是临时性的供货紧张。这对「capex 花得值」的多头逻辑是支撑，但对靠采购内存（而非自己生产）的厂商是利润压力。

alerts.body: Severity: HIGH Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=SpaceX+OR+SPCX+stock+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 17:58:59 GMT Link: https://news.google.?oc=5 SpaceX's First Lockup Expired Last Week. Why Didn't the Stock Crash? - The Globe and Mail SpaceX's First Lockup Expired Last Week. Why Didn't the Stock Crash?  The Globe and Mail ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A news headline asks why SpaceX shares didn't drop after the company's first post-IPO lock-up expiration last week, implying insiders were newly free to sell but the stock held up. 内容: 一则新闻标题在问：SpaceX 上周迎来 IPO 后首次解禁，为什么股价没有下跌——按理内部人此时可以自由卖出了，但股价撑住了。 Why it matters: A lock-up expiry that fails to trigger selling pressure either means insiders aren't dumping yet or demand is absorbing the new float — worth watching because C11's whole thesis is that staggered unlocks create mechanical, index-driven selling pressure independent of fundamentals; a no-crash outcome this early could mean the real stress is still ahead in later, larger tranches. 影响: 解禁后没砸盘，说明要么内部人还没开始抛，要么市场需求把新增流通盘吃掉了。这条值得盯，是因为 C11 整套逻辑就是分批解禁会带来和基本面无关的机械性抛压——这次没崩不代表没事，真正的压力可能在后面更大的解禁批次里。
